sentences.text:
=
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr.Saroj Kumar
 For the Respondent/s : Mr.Ram Naresh Ray
 ======================================================
 Coram: Honourable Mr. Justice Bibek Chaudhuri
 Oral Order
5 12-03-2024
1.
The instant revision is directed against an order of conviction affirmed by the learned Additional Sessions Judge, 4th Court, Madhubani in Cr. Appeal No. 24 of 2004.

2. The learned Judge in the Appellate Court, however, has modified the sentence, directing the petitioner to suffer imprisonment for the offence under Sections 494 and 498A of the Indian Penal Code for a period of six months each with further direction that the substantive sentence of imprisonment Patna High Court CR.
REV . No.721 of 2023(5) dt.12-03-2024 shall run concurrently.

The petitioner was also directed to pay compensation to the victim / informant / Opposite Party No.
2 a sum of R. 2,70,000/- as compensation.
3. The said order is under challenge in the instant revision.
5. The petitioner is directed to take steps for service of notice upon the private Opposite Party No. 2 by Registered Post with A/D as well as through Court.
The requisites to be filed by the petitioner within a period of seven days from the date of this order.
